the optimisation of insulin therapy and the improvement of the quality of life for patients with type 1 and type 2 diabetes mellitus.
the improvement of the metabolic control of type 2 diabetes by the optimisation of the insulin treatment and the education of people with diabetes.
the optimisation of treatment and teaching for patients with type 1 and type 2 diabetes.
